scope: Make Inspector-authored focus-visible styles keyboard reachable in the published renderer

assertions: responsive valid focus style detection follows inherited active-device values
focus preview reaches Canvas for each PARTIAL type
draft Save preserves the published focus appearance
separate Publish updates public focus styles for each type
non-native public nodes with focus styling become reachable by keyboard
native focusable elements receive no redundant tabindex
hover-only styling does not add keyboard tab stops
aria-hidden elements remain outside the keyboard order

acceptance_status: 77.44.7.A and WEB-011 remain OPEN; this covers keyboard reachability for one shared focus state route, not complete Editor acceptance
